# ECR

Manage repositories and push or pull images through a local Docker Registry API.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ecr` |
| Signing name | `ecr` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2015-09-21` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 26 of 58 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#ecr) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No replication, pull-through cache, scanning results, signing or KMS encryption.
- Registry policies and tag mutability exclusions are outside the subset.
- Deleted images do not trigger layer garbage collection.
- Repository policies are stored as metadata and are not evaluated.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
